ThemeContrastTest.kt:114 `tokens[name] ?: fail(...)` infers `Any`, because org.junit.Assert.fail() returns void, so `value ushr 24` (line 115) is unresolved and line 116 compares BigInteger to Int. Minimal test-side fix: `val value = tokens.getValue(name)` or `?: error("missing Theme.kt token $name")`.

Heads-up for the theme/badge lane: even with that test fixed, P9 would still fail — TagAgeLabelText on TagAgeLabelDarkBg = 4.47:1 (< 4.5) and ClinicalBadges.kt:124 still has copy(alpha = 0.65f). Not mine to change.
